verses.sloka: सीतां तु रुदतीं दृष्ट्वा ते तत्र मुनिदारकाः ।प्राद्रवन्यत्र भगवानास्ते वाल्मीकिरुग्रधीः ।। ७.४९.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sītāṁ tu rudatīṁ dṛṣṭvā te tatra munidārakāḥ ।prādravanyatra bhagavānāste vālmīkirugradhīḥ ।। 7.49.1 ॥

translations.english: Seeing Sita crying there, the hermit boys ran to where the revered Valmiki, of keen intellect, resided.
translations.hindi: उत्तरकारड का प्रक्षिप्त पाचवा सग समाप्त हुआ | 2, -४-:--- ० र सष्टचिशः सग; एवपास्ते महाबाहुरहन्यहनि राघवः । प्रशासत्सवकार्याणि पौरजानपदेषु च

verses.sloka: अभिवाद्य मुनेः पादौ मुनिपुत्रा महर्षये ।सर्वं निवेदयामासुस्तस्यास्तु रुदितस्वनम् ।। ७.४९.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: abhivādya muneḥ pādau muniputrā maharṣaye ।sarvaṁ nivedayāmāsustasyāstu ruditasvanam ।। 7.49.2 ॥

translations.english: Having saluted the feet of the great sage, the hermit boys reported to him everything about her crying.

verses.sloka: अदृष्टपूर्वा भगवन्कस्याप्येषा महात्मनः ।पत्नी श्रीरिव सम्मोहाद्विरौति विकृतानना ।। ७.४९.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭapūrvā bhagavankasyāpyeṣā mahātmanaḥ ।patnī śrīriva sammohādvirauti vikṛtānanā ।। 7.49.3 ॥

translations.english: O venerable one, this woman, never seen before, the wife of some great soul, cries out with a distorted face as if Lakshmi herself were deluded and wailing.
translations.hindi: महाराज ! आप सब प्रकार हमारे रक्षक हैं ओर हम आप ही के पाले हुए हैं। मैंने आप ही के उम्र तेज की सहायता से रावण को मारा है

verses.sloka: भगवन्साधु पश्य त्वं देवतामिव खाच्च्युताम् ।नद्यास्तु तीरे भगवन्वरस्त्री कापि दुःखिता ।। ७.४९.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhagavansādhu paśya tvaṁ devatāmiva khāccyutām ।nadyāstu tīre bhagavanvarastrī kāpi duḥkhitā ।। 7.49.4 ॥

translations.english: O venerable one, please observe carefully this excellent woman on the river bank, who appears distressed as if a goddess has fallen from the sky.
translations.hindi: हे ताता । भिथिकुल और इच्वाकुकुल के, इस अनुपम सम्बन्ध द्वार, आपस में बड़ी प्रीति है

verses.sloka: दृष्टास्माभिः प्ररुदिता दृढं शोकपरायणा ।अनर्हा दुःखशोकाभ्यामेकां दीनां ह्यनाथवत् ।। ७.४९.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭāsmābhiḥ praruditā dṛḍhaṁ śokaparāyaṇā ।anarhā duḥkhaśokābhyāmekāṁ dīnāṁ hyanāthavat ।। 7.49.5 ॥

translations.english: We have seen her weeping profusely, intensely overcome by grief, alone and miserable like an orphan, though she is undeserving of such sorrow and grief.

verses.sloka: न ह्येनां मानुषीं विद्मः सत्क्रिया ऽस्याः प्रयुज्यताम् ।आश्रमस्याविदूरे च त्वामियं शरणं गता ।। ७.४९.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: na hyenāṁ mānuṣīṁ vidmaḥ satkriyā 'syāḥ prayujyatām ।āśramasyāvidūre ca tvāmiyaṁ śaraṇaṁ gatā ।। 7.49.6 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, we do not believe her to be a human woman, so let proper hospitality be offered to her, as she has come seeking refuge with you near the hermitage.
translations.hindi: राजा जनक, श्रोरामचन्द्र जी के वचनों को मान कर उनसे बोले-हे राजन्‌ | सै आपकी नीतिमत्ता देख और आपका दुशेन कर प्रसन्न हुआ

verses.sloka: त्रातारमिच्छते साध्वी भगवंस्त्रातुमर्हसि ।तेषां तु वचनं श्रुत्वा बुद्ध्या निश्चित्य धर्मवित् ।तपसा लब्धचक्षुष्मान् प्राद्रवद्यत्र मैथिली ।। ७.४९.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: trātāramicchate sādhvī bhagavaṁstrātumarhasi ।teṣāṁ tu vacanaṁ śrutvā buddhyā niścitya dharmavit ।tapasā labdhacakṣuṣmān prādravadyatra maithilī ।। 7.49.7 ॥

translations.english: The virtuous woman desires a protector, O venerable one, and you ought to protect her; having heard their words, the knower of dharma, who had gained spiritual sight through asceticism, ascertained the situation with his intellect and rushed to where Maithili was.
translations.hindi: आपने मुके देने को जा वस्तुएँ इकट्ठी की हैं, में वे समस्त वस्तुएं अपनी बेटियों को दिये जाता न्‌

verses.sloka: तं प्रयान्तमभिप्रेत्य शिष्या ह्येनं महामतिम् ।तं तु देशमभि प्रेत्य किञ्चित्पद्भ्यां महामतिः ।। ७.४९.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ prayāntamabhipretya śiṣyā hyenaṁ mahāmatim ।taṁ tu deśamabhi pretya kiñcitpadbhyāṁ mahāmatiḥ ।। 7.49.8 ॥

translations.english: The great sage Valmiki, perceived by his disciples as he was departing, proceeded a short distance on foot towards a particular spot.
translations.hindi: जब राजा जनक चले गए, तब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने हाथ जाड़ कर, विनीतभाव से केकयराजपुत्र मामा युधाजित से कहा

verses.sloka: अर्घ्यमादाय रुचिरं जाह्नवीतीरमागमत् ।ददर्श राघवस्येष्टां सीतां पत्नीमनाथवत् ।। ७.४९.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: arghyamādāya ruciraṁ jāhnavītīramāgamat ।dadarśa rāghavasyeṣṭāṁ sītāṁ patnīmanāthavat ।। 7.49.9 ।।

translations.english: Having taken a beautiful offering, Valmiki arrived at the bank of the Ganga and there saw Sita, Rama's beloved wife, appearing helpless and unprotected.

verses.sloka: तां सीतां शोकभारार्तां वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुङ्गवः ।उवाच मधुरां वाणीं ह्लादयन्निव तेजसा ।। ७.४९.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: tāṁ sītāṁ śokabhārārtāṁ vālmīkirmunipuṅgavaḥ ।uvāca madhurāṁ vāṇīṁ hlādayanniva tejasā ।। 7.49.10 ॥

translations.english: The foremost sage Valmiki spoke sweet words to that Sita, who was afflicted by the burden of sorrow, as if comforting her with his spiritual radiance.
translations.hindi: केकयराज वृद्ध हैँ । वे तुम्हारे लिए सन्तप्न होते होंगे। अतः मेरी समझ में आज ही तुम्हारा जाना उचित है

verses.sloka: स्नुषा दशरथस्य त्वं रामस्य महिषी प्रिया ।जनकस्य सुता राज्ञः स्वागतं ते पतिव्रते ।। ७.४९.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: snuṣā daśarathasya tvaṁ rāmasya mahiṣī priyā ।janakasya sutā rājñaḥ svāgataṁ te pativrate ।। 7.49.11 ॥

translations.english: Valmiki addressed Sita, saying, "You are the daughter-in-law of Dasharatha, the beloved queen of Rama, and the daughter of King Janaka; welcome to you, O chaste wife."

verses.sloka: आयान्ती चासि विज्ञाता मया धर्मसमाधिना ।कारणं चैव सर्वं मे हृदयेनोपलक्षितम् ।। ७.४९.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: āyāntī cāsi vijñātā mayā dharmasamādhinā ।kāraṇaṁ caiva sarvaṁ me hṛdayenopalakṣitam ।। 7.49.12 ॥

translations.english: Valmiki further stated, "You, as you were coming, were known to me through my meditation on dharma, and indeed, all the reasons for your arrival have been discerned by my heart."
translations.hindi: तब युधाजित्‌ ने जाना स्वीकार करते हुए कहा-र्‍हे रामचन्द्र | यह सारा धन ओर रत्न अक्षय्य हो कर, तुम्हारे पास रहे

verses.sloka: तव चैव महाभागे विदितं मम तत्त्वतः ।सर्वं च विदितं मह्यं त्रैलोक्ये यद्धि वर्तते ।। ७.४९.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tava caiva mahābhāge viditaṁ mama tattvataḥ ।sarvaṁ ca viditaṁ mahyaṁ trailokye yaddhi vartate ।। 7.49.13 ॥

translations.english: O highly fortunate one, your true nature is indeed known to me, and everything that exists in the three worlds is also known to me.

verses.sloka: अपापां वेद्मि सीते त्वां तपोलब्धेन चक्षुषा ।विस्रब्धा भव वैदेहि साम्प्रतं मयि वर्तसे ।। ७.४९.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: apāpāṁ vedmi sīte tvāṁ tapolabdhena cakṣuṣā ।visrabdhā bhava vaidehi sāmprataṁ mayi vartase ।। 7.49.14 ॥

translations.english: O Sita, I know you to be sinless through the eye of wisdom gained by my penance; O Vaidehi, be confident, for you are now under my protection.
translations.hindi: लक्ष्मण सहित वे वहाँ से ऐसे चले जैसे वृत्रासुर के मारे जञाने पर इन्द्र, भगवान्‌ विष्णु के साथ चले थे

verses.sloka: आश्रमस्याविदूरे मे तापस्यस्तपसि स्थिताः ।तास्त्वां वत्से यथा वत्सं पालयिष्यन्ति नित्यशः ।। ७.४९.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: āśramasyāvidūre me tāpasyastapasi sthitāḥ ।tāstvāṁ vatse yathā vatsaṁ pālayiṣyanti nityaśaḥ ।। 7.49.15 ॥

translations.english: Not far from my hermitage, there are female ascetics engaged in penance, and they, O dear child, will always protect you as a mother protects her calf.
translations.hindi: उनको बिदा कर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने अपने मित्र काशी- नरेश राजा प्रतदेन को गले लगा कर कहा

verses.sloka: इदमर्ध्यं प्रतीच्छ त्वं विस्रब्धा विगतज्वरा ।यथा स्वगृहमभ्येत्य विषादं चैव मा कृथाः ।। ७.४९.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: idamardhyaṁ pratīccha tvaṁ visrabdhā vigatajvarā ।yathā svagṛhamabhyetya viṣādaṁ caiva mā kṛthāḥ ।। 7.49.16 ॥

translations.english: Accept this offering, confident and free from distress, and do not feel any sorrow, as if you have come to your own home.
translations.hindi: फिर कौसल्या के आनन्द को बढ़ाने वाले श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने उनको बिदा किआ । निडर काशिराज भी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की आज्ञा पा कर

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा तु भाषितं सीता मुनेः परममद्भुतम् ।शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य चरणौ तथेत्याह कृताञ्जलिः ।। ७.४९.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu bhāṣitaṁ sītā muneḥ paramamadbhutam ।śirasā ' 'vandya caraṇau tathetyāha kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। 7.49.17 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the supremely wonderful words of the sage, Sita, with folded hands, bowed down to his feet with her head and said, "So be it."

verses.sloka: तं प्रयान्तं मुनिं सीता प्राञ्जलिः पृष्ठतो ऽन्वगात् ।। ७.४९.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ prayāntaṁ muniṁ sītā prāñjaliḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nvagāt ।। 7.49.18 ॥

translations.english: Sita, with folded hands, followed the departing sage from behind.

verses.sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा मुनिमायान्तं वैदेह्या मुनिपत्नयः ।उपाजग्मुर्मुदा युक्ता वचनं चेदमब्रुवन् ।। ७.४९.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā munimāyāntaṁ vaidehyā munipatnayaḥ ।upājagmurmudā yuktā vacanaṁ cedamabruvan ।। 7.49.19 ॥

translations.english: Seeing the sage approaching with Vaidehi, the wives of the sages, filled with joy, came forward and spoke these words.

verses.sloka: स्वागतं ते मुनिश्रेष्ठ चिरस्यागमनं च ते ।अभिवादयामस्त्वां सर्वा उच्यतां कि च कुर्महे ।। ७.४९.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: svāgataṁ te muniśreṣṭha cirasyāgamanaṁ ca te ।abhivādayāmastvāṁ sarvā ucyatāṁ ki ca kurmahe ।। 7.49.20 ॥

translations.english: "Welcome to you, O best of sages; your arrival is after a long time; all of us salute you, please tell us what we should do."
translations.hindi: ओर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से बिदा किये जा कर, तुरन्त काशी को चल दिए। काशीनाथ को बिदा कर, अन्य तीन सौ राजाओं

verses.sloka: तासां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वाल्मीकिरिदमब्रवीत् ।सीतेयं समनुप्राप्ता पत्नी रामस्य धीमतः ।। ७.४९.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāsāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā vālmīkiridamabravīt ।sīteyaṁ samanuprāptā patnī rāmasya dhīmataḥ ।। 7.49.21 ॥

translations.english: Having heard their words, Valmiki spoke this: "This is Sita, the wife of the wise Rama, who has arrived."

verses.sloka: स्नुषा दशरथस्यैषा जनकस्य सुता सती ।अपापा पतिना त्यक्ता परिपाल्या मया सदा ।। ७.४९.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: snuṣā daśarathasyaiṣā janakasya sutā satī ।apāpā patinā tyaktā paripālyā mayā sadā ।। 7.49.22 ॥

translations.english: "She is the daughter-in-law of Dasharatha and the chaste daughter of Janaka; though sinless, she has been abandoned by her husband and must always be protected by me."
translations.hindi: से श्रीरामचन्द्र जी मुसक्याते हुए मधुर वाणी से बोले-- झा ल की हममें निश्चल प्रीति हे जो, आपके तेज से रांक्षत धर्मश्च नियतो नित्यं सत्यं च भवर्ता सदा । . युष्माकं चानुभावेन तेजसा च महात्मनाम्‌

verses.sloka: इमां भवन्त्यः(?) पश्यन्तु स्नेहेन परमेण हि ।गौरवान्मम वाक्याच्च पूज्या वो ऽस्तु विशेषतः ।। ७.४९.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: imāṁ bhavantyaḥ(?) paśyantu snehena parameṇa hi ।gauravānmama vākyācca pūjyā vo 'stu viśeṣataḥ ।। 7.49.23 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, may you all regard her with supreme affection, and especially, let her be worthy of your reverence out of respect for my words.

verses.sloka: मुहुर्मुहुश्च वैदेहीं प्रणिधाय महायशाः ।स्वमाश्रमं शिष्यवृतः पुनरायान्महातपाः ।। ७.४९.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: muhurmuhuśca vaidehīṁ praṇidhāya mahāyaśāḥ ।svamāśramaṁ śiṣyavṛtaḥ punarāyānmahātapāḥ ।। 7.49.24 ।।

translations.english: And having repeatedly entrusted Vaidehi, the greatly renowned and great ascetic Valmiki, surrounded by his disciples, returned to his own hermitage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 49 ।। Thus ends the forty-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: ॥ राब्रणः सगणो यद्ध सपुत्रामात्यवान्धवः | ०८-०. एभबस्वळ्या समागिता अ तेन स हपत्मःचा०१ २८५१ ९5२ _ उन्तरकाण्डे सो भी बह अकेला नहीं बल्कि सेना, मंत्री तथा अपने बंधु- बान्धवो सहित मारा गया है । ( सुमे विदित हुआ हे कि) महात्मा भारत जी ने आप लोगों को यहाँ ( लङ्का के युद्ध में मेरी सहायता करने को ) बुलाया था
